title: Wardrobe face zones
description: The parts of a make-up look (lips, cheeks, eyelid…), in the order the look editor lists them: which make-up types fit each, and which colours of a colour season to suggest for it.

id.description: Stable id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Saved looks refer to it, so it is never renamed or reused once shipped.

types.description: Ids from cosmetic-types.json whose shades fit this zone; a group id (lips) takes every type in it.

from.description: Which part of the season palette suggestions come from: its colours, its neutrals, or both.

hue.description: LCh hue angle range in degrees, [from, to]; it may wrap past 360 (from greater than to). Suggestions outside it are left out.

lightness.description: CIE L* range [min, max] for suggestions (0 black, 100 white).

minChroma.description: Least CIE chroma for suggestions, to leave greys out (lips).
